Unusual 31.6K distance as a step to the full marathon
Fundraiser for Rotary Bangalore IT Corridor community projects since 2007
tips: Report 30 to 60 minutes before your start: 6:00 PM for 5K races, 8:00 PM for 10K, 10:30 PM for half, 31.6K and full.
Bibs must be collected in person (or by a representative with written consent) before race night; check the BIB Collection page for the expo venue.
The Purple Line metro reaches Whitefield (Kadugodi) and Hoodi but stops running before the long races finish, so pre-book a return cab or stay near Whitefield.
December nights in Bengaluru drop to about 15 to 18 C by early morning; keep a warm layer for the start area and after finishing.
On a short loop course you can stage personal nutrition at the start/finish area and pace off loop splits.

events.name: Pune International Marathon
events.venue: Baburao Sanas Sports Ground, Saras Baug (start and finish)
events.registration_notes: Standard fees shown; early-bird prices (FM 1,600, HM 1,200, 10K 800, 5K 650) end 31 Oct 2026. Offline group registration at Marathon Bhavan, Parvati. Non-refundable; category changes up to 45 days before race day.
events.summary: India's oldest marathon, reaching its 40th edition in 2026, run through the historic streets of central Pune. It is an AIMS member race with Athletics Federation of India national marathon championship status and a prize pool of over Rs 50 lakh. Known for its very early pre-dawn start in cool December weather.

categories.name: Marathon
categories.notes: Start time per a third-party race guide; confirm in the race guide. Course closes 9:30 AM.

categories.name: Wheelchair Run
categories.eligibility: Wheelchair users
categories.notes: Not timed. Some listings give 3.5 km.

course.description: Starts and finishes at Sanas Ground near Saras Baug and loops through central Pune's old city streets. Traffic-free until 9:30 AM, with aid stations until 10:00 AM.

highlights: AIMS member and AFI national marathon championship
Low entry fees for a full marathon
tips: The start is in the middle of the night: leave by 2:30-2:45 AM, pre-book a cab the evening before and arrive by 3:00 AM.
Early December temperatures are about 12-15 C at the start rising to around 20 C by 8 AM, so wear a throwaway layer and consider a head torch for the first 30-45 minutes.
Carry your own gels for the half and full; aid stations offer water and energy drinks.
Parking around Saras Baug is limited and at your own risk; a drop-off is easier.
Expo and bib collection details are published closer to race day on marathonpune.com.

events.name: Bajaj Pune Marathon
events.venue: Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex (National Games complex), Mhalunge-Balewadi (start and finish)
events.organiser: Sakal with India Running (title sponsor Bajaj)
events.registration_notes: Fees listed are the standard men's rate; women get 50% off every category (e.g. HM INR 900). Photo ID required. Elite category free for Indian citizens.
events.summary: Pune's large December road race, formerly the Bajaj Allianz Pune Half Marathon, which added a full marathon in 2025. It is run from the Balewadi sports complex in west Pune with chip-timed 5K, 10K, half and full marathon races. Elite prize money is offered for the half marathon and 10K.

course.description: Starts and finishes at the Balewadi sports complex in Mhalunge, west Pune, on city roads around Baner and Balewadi.

highlights: Formerly the Bajaj Allianz Pune Half Marathon
RFID chip timing and timing SMS
tips: Cutoffs are measured from the gun, not your chip time; the 3-hour half marathon cutoff is tight for back-of-pack runners starting late.
Balewadi is about 12 km from central Pune; book a cab or stay near Baner or Balewadi for the early start.
Mid-December mornings in Pune are cool, typically low to mid teens C at dawn, so bring a warm layer for the wait.
Registration closes 4 Dec 2026 or earlier if categories sell out, as they have in past years.

events.name: Careothon
events.venue: Salt Lake City, Kolkata (exact start not published)
events.registration_notes: Fees and registration link not published on the listing; contact carekankurgachi@gmail.com or 9830096405. Entry fees non-refundable unless the organiser cancels.
events.summary: Long-running community race in Salt Lake organised by Care Kankurgachi under the banner 'Let's Run To Care', now in its ninth edition. Offers a half marathon, 10K and timed 5K with age-category trophies, hot breakfast and a Zumba session.

categories.name: Half Marathon
categories.notes: Listing gives a 4:00 am event start and requires all runners to finish by 8:00 am.

course.description: Road course in Salt Lake (Bidhannagar). Route not published.

highlights: Ninth edition of a local Salt Lake race
tips: Very early start: the event begins at 4:00 am and runners must finish by 8:00 am, so arrange transport the night before.
Mid-December mornings in Kolkata are cool and hazy; dress in layers and check air quality.
Minimum ages are counted on race day (born on or before 13 December of the qualifying year).

events.name: Mysuru Marathon
events.venue: Police Grounds, Mysuru (start/finish)
events.registration_notes: NEB Sports lists fees from Rs 450; per-category fees not captured.
events.summary: NEB Sports' December road race in the heritage city of Mysuru, three weeks after the Kaveri Trail Marathon nearby. Full, half, 10K and 5K.

course.description: City course around Mysuru's heritage core.

tips: Mid-December dawns in Mysuru are cool and dry; good conditions for a PB.
Pairs well with the Kaveri Trail Marathon on 22 Nov at nearby Srirangapatna as a build-up race.
NEB Sports allows changes only up to 60 days before race day.

events.name: OMC Puri Coastal Marathon
events.venue: Blue Flag Beach, Puri (start); finish on Puri-Konark Marine Drive
events.organiser: Odisha Mining Corporation (OMC), with Odisha Tourism
events.registration_notes: Fees, start times and cutoffs below are from a third-party guide; not shown on the official page.
events.summary: New coastal marathon in Puri, about 60 km from Bhubaneswar, presented by the state mining corporation. Every category includes a 5 km stretch on beach sand.

categories.name: 5K Fun Run
categories.notes: Official site says open to all; min age 10 per race guide.

course.surface: tarmac with a 5 km beach-sand section
course.description: Point-to-point from Puri's Blue Flag Beach across the Nuanai river onto the Puri-Konark Marine Drive.

highlights: 5 km of beach running in every category
tips: Train some runs on soft sand; consider gaiters for the beach section.
Puri is about 60 km from Bhubaneswar; stay in Puri the night before for the 4:30 AM start.
Point-to-point course: check finish-to-start transport before race day.

events.name: Run for Our National Heroes

events.registration_notes: Registration on IndiaRunning. Single fee per category listed, no early-bird tier shown.
events.summary: Community road race in Besant Nagar organised by Gagner Sports as a tribute to India's armed forces. It offers a 3K fun run and timed 5K, 10K and 16K (10 mile) races, with trophies and Decathlon vouchers for the top three men and women in each age category.

categories.name: 16K Timed Run
categories.notes: 10 mile distance. 05:30 is the listed event start; per-category flag-offs not published.

course.description: Start and finish at Olcott Memorial School in Besant Nagar, close to Elliot's Beach. Route not yet published.

tips: Reporting starts at 5:30 am; Besant Nagar's inner streets are narrow, so arrive early or take a cab.
Mid-December mornings in Chennai are mild, but late northeast monsoon showers are still possible.
Bib collection, timing certificate and photo details will be shared by the organiser closer to the date.

events.name: SKF Goa River Marathon
events.venue: Chicalim Panchayat Ground, South Goa (start/finish)
events.organiser: Goa River Marathon organising team (title sponsor SKF)
events.registration_notes: A worldsmarathons.com listing gives 25 Nov 2026 as the closing date; not confirmed on the official site. Fees below are from a third-party guide.
events.summary: Long-running December road race along the Zuari river in South Goa, started in 2012. Unusual 32K '20-miler' option alongside the full, half, 10K and 5K.

categories.name: Full Marathon
categories.eligibility: Proof of a previous full marathon under 6 hours or half marathon under 2:45 (per race guide)

course.description: Flat, tree-lined out-and-back route along the Zuari river.

tips: Chicalim is next to Dabolim airport and Vasco, far from North Goa beaches; stay in Vasco or Bogmalo to avoid a long pre-dawn drive.
Arrive 45-60 minutes before your wave start.
Keep proof of a qualifying time ready if you enter the full marathon.

events.name: Vasai-Virar Mayor's Marathon
events.venue: Viva College, Virar West (full marathon start and finish)

events.registration_notes: Online registration opened 15 Oct 2026, 6:00 AM. Fees exclude GST and processing charges. Offline registration at the VVCMC Sports Department, New Administrative Building, Yashwant Nagar, Virar West. The site's event-details page already shows 'slots filled', so check availability quickly.
events.summary: National-level municipal marathon in the Vasai-Virar belt north of Mumbai, held since 2011 and recognised by the Athletics Federation of India on an AIMS-certified course. The 2026 edition has a Rs 58 lakh prize fund open to Indian athletes and one of the lowest entry fees for a full marathon in India. Editions regularly draw over 20,000 participants.

categories.name: Full Marathon
categories.notes: Fee excludes GST and processing fee.

categories.name: Half Marathon
categories.notes: Point-to-point: starts outside Vasai Tahsildar Office, Vasai village, finishes at Viva College. Fee excludes GST.

categories.name: Dhamaal Dhaav (fun run)
categories.notes: Untimed community run; refreshments only, no medal or T-shirt. Separate junior races (ages 10-18) and senior citizen and para events are also held.

course.description: Full marathon starts and finishes at Viva College, Virar West. Half marathon runs point-to-point from Vasai village to Viva College. AIMS-certified course; the men's marathon course record is 2:18:05.

highlights: Rs 58 lakh prize fund for Indian athletes
Free accommodation and meals offered to outstation participants
tips: Previous editions ran free shuttles from Virar station to the full marathon start and from Vasai Road station to the half marathon start; confirm this year's shuttle details.
Bib with timing chip and the event T-shirt are handed out on a bib distribution day before the race; carry ID.
Mid-December is the best weather window for running in the Mumbai region; 2024 runners cited pleasant conditions.
Half marathoners finish at a different place from where they start, so plan how to get back to Vasai.

events.name: Vizag Navy Marathon
events.venue: RK Beach, Visakhapatnam (start; finish at Park Circle, RK Beach)
events.registration_notes: Early-bird offer valid up to 31 Oct 2026; fees shown are those on the official site and may rise after that. Armed Forces personnel register through a separate Navy portal.
events.summary: Navy Day road race on Visakhapatnam's Beach Road, organised by the Eastern Naval Command. Participation grew from about 4,000 in 2014 to 17,000 in 2025. Route accredited by AIMS, with prize money of about Rs 10 lakh.

course.description: Traffic-free Beach Road course along the Bay of Bengal from RK Beach; longer distances have gentle rolling sections, per race guide. AIMS accredited.

highlights: Part of Indian Navy Day celebrations
tips: Register before 31 Oct 2026 to get the early-bird offer.
Arrive about 60 minutes before your wave; bib expos in past years were at naval venues such as the Sailors Institute.
Beach Road has gentle climbs on the longer routes; include some hill work in training.

events.summary: Charity half marathon in BKC organised by a Rotary club, with proceeds supporting education and empowerment of specially-abled children. Offers chip-timed 5K, 10K and 21.1K races plus an untimed 2.5K fun run, with age-group trophies.

categories.name: 10K Timed Run
categories.notes: Reporting 05:30. Note 18+ age limit for the 10K.

course.description: Course on the wide roads of Bandra Kurla Complex, starting from Bharat Diamond Bourse. Route map not yet published.

highlights: Age-group trophies for top 3 in each band
Flat BKC roads with staggered starts
tips: Race kits are collected at a bib expo 1-2 days before the race with photo ID; there is no race-morning collection mentioned.
BKC is a cab ride from Bandra or Kurla stations; arrange transport for the 5:00 AM reporting time.
Late December has Mumbai's coolest mornings of the year, good for a half marathon PB attempt.
Register in the correct age band: runners in an ineligible category are not considered for prizes.

Bib and kit collection date and venue are announced closer to race day.

events.name: Tata Steel World 25K Kolkata

Start and finish are on Red Road beside the Maidan.

categories.notes: Start waves A to D seeded by certificate time. Timing certificate only for finishes within 4 hours 30 minutes.

categories.notes: Non-timed fun run of about 4.8 km.

categories.name: Senior Citizens' Run
categories.eligibility: Senior citizens

Start waves seeded by timing certificate
Red Road start beside the Maidan
tips: Book a bib collection slot for the PLAYSCAPE expo (17 to 19 Dec 2026); Kolkata residents are asked to use 17 and 18 Dec and leave 19 Dec for outstation runners. Every runner must collect in person.
Baggage tags are limited and carry a refundable INR 500 deposit; pick one during registration or from your profile.
Start wave change requests with a faster certificate close on 20 Nov 2026 (email tsw25k@procam.in).
Late December dawns in Kolkata are cool (mid-teens C) and often hazy with poor air quality; bring a throwaway layer for the start pen and check AQI.
Roads around the Maidan close early; Esplanade and Maidan metro stations are closest, but plan a cab if trains do not run before the 05:34 start.

events.name: Udupi Marathon
events.venue: Mahatma Gandhi District Stadium, Ajjarkad, Udupi
events.registration_notes: Fees shown are the standard 'final' prices; lower offer prices apply while they last (Rs 1,250 full, 1,000 half, 700 10K, 500 5K).
events.summary: Coastal Karnataka road race in Udupi, about 55 km north of Mangaluru, run by NEB Sports on a looped course.

course.description: Looped course through Udupi town; full route details pending.

highlights: Strict cutoffs including a 3-hour first loop for the full
tips: Register early to get the offer price, which is less than half the final price for the full marathon.
Coastal humidity stays high in December; carry electrolytes.
Udupi railway station is on the Konkan line, convenient from Mangaluru and Goa.

events.name: Walkaroo Coimbatore Marathon

course.description: Fast, flat city course per organiser.

highlights: Free training programme before race day
tips: Roads reopen and aid stations close at 8:30 AM; slower half marathoners should target well under 3:30.
Join the organiser's free training sessions in the build-up.
Start venue and timings were still 'stay tuned' in mid-October; watch the FAQ page.

events.summary: Community half marathon in Pimpri-Chinchwad, the industrial twin city of Pune, in its 6th edition. Offers a timed half marathon, 10K and 5K plus a non-timed Saree Run. Winners for the 10K and half marathon are decided by gun time.

categories.eligibility: Wearing a saree is compulsory

highlights: Free race photos with face recognition
Cash prizes and trophies for winners
tips: Bibs must be collected in person at the expo; a representative needs your confirmation and government photo ID.
Late December mornings in Pune are the coldest of the year, often around 10 C at dawn, so bring a warm layer.
Pimple Saudagar is in the north-west, about 15 km from central Pune; staying in Aundh, Wakad or Pimple Saudagar avoids a long pre-dawn drive.
Pets and wheeled vehicles (including prams) are not allowed on course.

events.name: Freshworks Chennai Marathon

The 2027 race is the 15th edition.

categories.notes: 2027 fee and timings not yet published. In 2026 the full marathon flagged off at about 04:00 from Napier Bridge, with a 28 km checkpoint cutoff of 4 hours 30 minutes (third-party race guide).

Four distances including a 32 km Twenty Miler
Finish at Indian Maritime University on the East Coast Road
tips: Bib collection at the expo is mandatory and there is no race-day pickup; carry proof of age. A representative can collect with your signed authorisation letter and a copy of their ID.
The finish at IMU Uthandi is far south of the start, so plan your return: organisers run limited buses back to the start for half, 32K and full finishers.
In 2026 registered runners got early, free Chennai Metro travel on race morning via a QR code on the bib; check the 2027 runner guide for transport arrangements.
Early January is Chennai's coolest month, but humidity builds fast after sunrise; full marathoners should front-load fluids and electrolytes.
Bring a small light or reflective gear for the pre-dawn start and use the baggage counters at the start rather than carrying a bag.
amenities: Finisher medal and e-certificate for finishers within cutoff

events.name: EKAL Run

events.organiser: Friends of Tribals Society (FTS) and FTS Yuva
events.registration_notes: Flat fee for every distance: early bird INR 700, regular INR 800 (regular used below). Early-bird end date not stated.
events.summary: Charity run raising funds for Ekal Vidyalaya one-teacher schools for children in tribal and rural India, organised by Friends of Tribals Society and its youth wing. Over 5,000 registrations at the previous edition

Reporting and flag-off times and bib collection details are still to be announced; follow the organiser's Instagram for updates.

events.name: Tata Mumbai Marathon

Marathon and half marathon need a valid timing certificate from a race held on or after 17 Jul 2025. Charity bibs available for those who missed open registration.

categories.name: Open 10K

categories.notes: Domestic fee incl. GST; overseas USD 45. Start time from 2026 edition (CSMT).

Large charity fundraising platform with dedicated charity bibs
tips: Bibs are only handed out at the PLAYSCAPE TMM 2027 Expo, 14-16 Jan 2027, in pre-booked slots; nothing is posted and collection closes 5 pm on Saturday 16 Jan. The 2026 expo was at Kalina University Sports Ground, Santacruz East.

Cash prizes for top 10 in each age group
tips: Roads around TMC headquarters (Nitin Company junction, Almeida signal, Kamgar Nagar Naka) close from the evening before, so walk in from Thane station, about 1.5 km away.

events.summary: Long-running community half marathon in Gurugram, held for the 9th time on 6 September 2026 at Urban Akhara, Sector 58. It offers 21.1 km, 10.55 km, 5.25 km and 3 km races with chip timing on the three longer distances.

tips: Bib expo details are emailed after registration closes, and local runners cannot collect bibs on race day.

Report 30 minutes before your flag-off; parking and a baggage counter are available at Urban Akhara.

events.name: Wipro Bengaluru Marathon
events.venue: Sree Kanteerava Stadium (start and finish)
events.registration_notes: Online only, no manual registrations. 2026 registrations closed before race day. Cancellation up to 60 days before the race carries a Rs 250 processing charge.
events.summary: Bengaluru's flagship city marathon, held on a late-September Sunday from Sree Kanteerava Stadium with full, half, 10K and 5K races. The 2025 edition drew over 35,000 runners, and the Spirit of Wipro Run (14,000+ Bengaluru participants in 2025) is run alongside it. The full marathon is AIMS-certified.

categories.name: Full Marathon
categories.notes: First loop must be completed within 3 hours. 2026 listings showed Rs 2,000, possibly an early-bird price; 2027 fee not published. Min age per 2026 guide.

categories.name: Half Marathon
categories.notes: 2026 listings showed Rs 1,500, possibly an early-bird price; 2027 fee not published.

categories.name: 5K Fun Run
categories.notes: Non-timed. Children under 12 must run with a registered parent or guardian.

course.description: Starts and finishes at Sree Kanteerava Stadium in central Bengaluru; the full marathon is a two-loop course on tree-lined city roads with gentle, constant undulation and no single major climb.

highlights: Integrated with the Spirit of Wipro Run in Bengaluru
Registration kit includes timing bib, race-day T-shirt, finisher medal and hot breakfast
tips: Bibs are only issued at the pre-race expo, usually held in the 2-3 days before the race; there is no race-morning bib collection.
Sir M. Visvesvaraya (Central College) metro station on the Purple Line is about 1 km from the stadium; roads around it close early, so arrive by metro or stay within 3-4 km.
Late September is post-monsoon in Bengaluru with start temperatures around 18-24 C and a chance of showers.
The full marathon has a 3-hour first-loop cutoff; runners who miss intermediate cutoffs lose an official finish time.
Include hilly long runs in training, as the course undulates throughout.
